branchName.instructions:
Use the repository branch convention exactly:

feat|fix|docs|chore/mesp-<n>-<short-slug>

Respect the current TASK.md and GitHub work-item authority.
Do not invent a branch when the task requires an existing branch or main.
One bounded concern per branch.

commitMessage.instructions:
Use one concise Conventional Commit subject.

Reference the owning work item as:
MESP-<n> (#<issue>)

Use the module/area as the conventional scope where useful.

No body unless materially necessary.

pullRequest.instructions:
Keep concise.

Include only:
- Summary
- MESP work item / GitHub Issue
- Validation
- LocalDB/SQL evidence when applicable
- Risks/blockers
- Explicit STOP / Ready / merge authority

Never infer Ready or merge authority from passing tests or reviews.
Do not repeat full task history.
